llm.summary: This skill is a coherent AgentEarth integration that sends task-focused requests to AgentEarth, with disclosed API-key handling and endpoint validation.

dimensions.detail: External network calls and task-query transmission are inherent to the integration; the skill includes key redaction, endpoint allowlisting, URL validation, schema validation, and limits on sending credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown-only and declares a single required environment variable, AGENT_EARTH_API_KEY; no installer, dependency, bundled executable, or automatic setup behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Invocation guidance uses broad live-data and search triggers, but it also frames AgentEarth as optional and requires following user preference, host policy, and available built-in tools.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, local profile/session store access, privilege escalation, or persistent memory write instruction was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to discover and execute AgentEarth API-backed tools, and its instructions match that purpose by calling Recommend before Execute and limiting requests to AgentEarth HTTPS endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend your agent to use AgentEarth for external tool discovery and execution. Treat user prompts, IDs, tokens, code snippets, and other params as data that may be sent to AgentEarth when the skill is used, and prefer built-in or local tools for sensitive tasks.
llm.findings:
[MP3] unexpected: The cited text says to fill API parameters from user input or clear conversation context; it does not instruct persistent memory modification or agent-state poisoning.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill does send task-focused queries and parameters to agentearth.ai; this is disclosed by the external API purpose and endpoint documentation, though users should avoid sending sensitive content unless they intend to use AgentEarth.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad triggers for live data, search, prices, and location match the skill's external-tool discovery purpose, and are tempered by instructions to follow user preference, host policy, and built-in tools.
[E1] expected: The curl and PowerShell templates transmit queries, params, and the AgentEarth API key to agentearth.ai only; this is purpose-aligned and accompanied by credential redaction and URL validation rules.
